critical_bugs_needing_attention.title: deepseek harness coding partner fails to start — credentials file format incompatible with dsh 0.1.1-rc.2
critical_bugs_needing_attention.reason: All users of DSH integration blocked on startup. Cherry writes API key as top-level key, incompatible with version:1 + refs: format required by new dsh.

critical_bugs_needing_attention.title: Multimodal content block built incorrectly — images not passed to vision models in single-model chat
critical_bugs_needing_attention.reason: Core vision feature broken for GLM-4V-Flash 1213, DeepSeek vision and likely others.

critical_bugs_needing_attention.title: Pi and DSH runtimes do not inherit user's CLI PATH on macOS
critical_bugs_needing_attention.reason: Agent subprocesses cannot find user-installed tools (brew, nvm, etc.). Breaks all macOS agent workflows relying on custom PATH.

critical_bugs_needing_attention.title: Referenced conversations can trigger actions without a current user request
critical_bugs_needing_attention.reason: Security/UX concern: background conversation references executing agent actions autonomously.

critical_bugs_needing_attention.title: Agent heartbeat interval no longer schedules anything — ensureHeartbeatTask dropped in JobManager migration
critical_bugs_needing_attention.reason: Silent regression: agent background tasks (health checks, timeouts) never fire. Affects all agent sessions.

critical_bugs_needing_attention.title: Agent output stops mid-generation — tool_calls emitted as plain text in thinking block
critical_bugs_needing_attention.reason: Dead-loop: model sends tool_calls in thinking text, parser does not detect them, injects 'no visible output' repeatedly.

critical_bugs_needing_attention.title: Agent stream stuck/empty after manual interrupt + immediate regenerate
critical_bugs_needing_attention.reason: Reproducible race on stop+regenerate: empty stream (11ms/$0) or frozen UI.

critical_bugs_needing_attention.title: v2.0.8 bundle missing #18702 and #18121 fixes (response_format retry + reasoning_content)
critical_bugs_needing_attention.reason: Release QA gap confirmed: two known fixes absent from shipped bundle. Affects all v2.0.8 users.
